title: Mark
description: A plain <mark> highlights text; variant picks a success, warning, danger or info colour, and color sets any colour with the text colour chosen to stay readable.

variant.description: Semantic highlight colour: `success`, `warning`, `danger` or `info`. **Ignored when `color` is set** — an explicit colour wins.

color.description: Any CSS colour, used as the highlight background. The text colour is computed from its luminance so the mark stays readable, and setting this overrides `variant`.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
